marker: # ref_size is the product length measured in the LVS assembly GCA_000009245.1 (AM233362.1) by in silico
# PCR with these primers, outer primer edge to outer primer edge. Every marker gave exactly one product.
# unit_length is not published in the source table. It is filled for the seven loci where two
# independent lines of evidence agree, and left empty for the other four.
# The first line of evidence is a cross strain test. A locus keeps the same flanking length in every
# strain, so the sizes of its product must differ by whole multiples of the repeat unit. Amplifying
# this panel in seven Francisella genomes, SCHU S4, LVS, OSU18, WY96-3418, FSC198, NE061598 and
# TI0902, gives the step sizes below. The second is the bundled scheme francisella_johansson_2004,
# which derives a unit for the same locus from a different primer pair and a different reference.
#   locus    steps seen    Johansson locus and unit    unit recorded here
#   Ft-M02   12            Ft-M2   6 bp                 6   (12 is two units)
#   Ft-M03   9            Ft-M3   9 bp                 9
#   Ft-M04   5            Ft-M4   5 bp                 5
#   Ft-M05   16            Ft-M5  16 bp                16
#   Ft-M06   21            Ft-M6  21 bp                21
#   Ft-M10   256           Ft-M10 16 bp                16  (256 is sixteen units)
#   Ft-M20A  12            Ft-M20 12 bp                12
#   Ft-M20B  one size only Ft-M20 12 bp                none, no cross strain evidence
#   Ft-M22   steps 6,6,19  no unit in Johansson        none
#   Ft-M23   one step, 23  no unit in Johansson        none
#   Ft-M24   steps 5,16    no unit in Johansson        none
# THE LOCUS NAMES OF THE TWO BUNDLED FRANCISELLA SCHEMES DIFFER ONLY IN SPELLING. This scheme pads
# the number, Ft-M02, where francisella_johansson_2004 does not, Ft-M2, and the unit lengths above
# confirm that the padded and unpadded names are the same VNTR. The two schemes still amplify it
# with different primer pairs and are anchored on different strains, LVS here and SCHU S4 there, so
# their products differ in size and their alleles are not interchangeable. Ft-M20 of that scheme is
# split here into Ft-M20A and Ft-M20B.
# ref_repeats is not published either and is not filled. The cross strain test fixes a flanking
# length only up to a whole number of repeats, so it cannot supply the absolute count, and the
# source table gives no reference values. Every marker is therefore sized and reported
# NO_DEFINITION rather than called.
